source.text: רַנְּנ֣וּ צַ֭דִּיקִים בַּֽיהוָ֑ה לַ֝יְשָׁרִ֗ים נָאוָ֥ה תְהִלָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Shout for joy, righteous [ones], in YHWH; for the upright praise [is] fitting.

en.L: Shout for joy, righteous [ones], in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; for the upright praise [is] fitting.
en.B: Sing for joy in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, you righteous; praise suits those who are upright.
en.R: People who do what is right, shout for joy because of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! It is right for honest people to praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

fr.L: Poussez des cris de joie, justes, en {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; aux hommes droits la louange [est] convenable.
fr.B: Chantez de joie en {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, vous les justes ; la louange va bien à ceux qui ont le cœur droit.
fr.R: Vous qui faites ce qui est juste, criez de joie à cause {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ! Il est bon que les gens honnêtes {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} louent.

sw.L: Pigeni kelele za furaha, enyi wenye haki, katika {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; kwa wanyofu sifa [ni] zinazofaa.
sw.B: Imbeni kwa furaha katika {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, enyi wenye haki; sifa zinawafaa walio wanyofu.
sw.R: Enyi watu mnaotenda haki, pigeni kelele za furaha kwa sababu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Ni vyema watu wanyofu wamsifu.

es.L: {{plural_you:Griten|Gritad}} de júbilo, justos, en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; a los rectos [les] sienta bien la alabanza.
es.B: {{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} con alegría en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, justos; la alabanza es propia de los rectos.
es.R: Gente que hace lo correcto, ¡{{plural_you:griten|gritad}} de alegría por causa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}! Es bueno que las personas honradas {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} alaben.

vi.L: Hãy reo mừng, hỡi những người công chính, trong {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; đối với người ngay thẳng, lời ca ngợi [là] thích đáng.
vi.B: Hỡi những người công chính, hãy hát mừng trong {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; lời ca ngợi thật xứng hợp cho những người ngay thẳng.
vi.R: Hỡi những người sống ngay lành, hãy reo mừng vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! Người ngay thật ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là điều đúng đắn.

decisions.reason: Psalm 33 is one of the few psalms in Psalms 1-41 with no title. Its first words take up the last line of Psalm 32 ("shout for joy ... righteous"), and it is a song of praise to the LORD as Creator and ruler of the nations.

decisions.choice: fitting: what is right and becoming
decisions.reason: Praise suits the upright (147:1): it is the natural response of those who are right with God.
Readable says whom the praise is for.

source.text: הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה בְּכִנּ֑וֹר בְּנֵ֥בֶל עָ֝שׂ֗וֹר זַמְּרוּ־לֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Give thanks to YHWH with [the] lyre; with [the] harp of ten make music to him.

en.L: Give thanks to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with [the] lyre; with [the] harp of ten [strings] make music to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: Thank {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} on the lyre; play music for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} on the ten-stringed harp.
en.R: Thank {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with music on the lyre. Play songs for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} on a harp with ten strings.

fr.L: Rendez grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} avec [la] lyre ; avec [la] harpe à dix [cordes] jouez pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: Rendez grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} sur la lyre ; jouez pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} sur la harpe à dix cordes.
fr.R: Remerciez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} en jouant de la lyre. Jouez des chants pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} sur une harpe à dix cordes.

sw.L: Mshukuruni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa kinubi; kwa kinanda cha [nyuzi] kumi mpigieni muziki.
sw.B: Mshukuruni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa kinubi; mpigieni muziki kwa kinanda chenye nyuzi kumi.
sw.R: Mshukuruni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa muziki wa kinubi. Mpigieni nyimbo kwa kinanda chenye nyuzi kumi.

es.L: {{plural_you:Den|Dad}} gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} con [la] lira; con [el] arpa de diez [cuerdas] {{plural_you:tóquenle|tocadle}} música.
es.B: {{plural_you:Denle|Dadle}} gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} con la lira; {{plural_you:toquen|tocad}} música para {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} con el arpa de diez cuerdas.
es.R: {{plural_you:Den|Dad}} gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} con música de lira. {{plural_you:Tóquenle|Tocadle}} canciones con un arpa de diez cuerdas.

vi.L: Hãy cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} bằng đàn lia; bằng đàn hạc mười [dây] hãy tấu nhạc cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Hãy cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} bằng đàn lia; hãy đàn cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nghe trên cây đàn hạc mười dây.
vi.R: Hãy cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} bằng tiếng đàn lia. Hãy chơi nhạc cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên cây đàn hạc mười dây.

decisions.choice: lyre and harp: two stringed instruments
decisions.reason: The kinnor was a lyre, a light instrument held in the hands; the nevel was a larger stringed instrument. Both were played in worship (1 Chronicles 15:16; 2 Samuel 6:5).

decisions.choice: harp of ten: a ten-stringed harp
decisions.reason: The word "ten" stands beside "harp" and is taken as describing it (144:9); in 92:4 the two are named side by side.

decisions.choice: "đàn lia" and "đàn hạc" for the two stringed instruments
decisions.reason: These are two different stringed instruments (see the meaning decision); "đàn lia" (lyre) and "đàn hạc" (harp) are names a modern reader can picture, where "đàn cầm, đàn sắt" are older literary words.

source.text: שִֽׁירוּ־ל֭וֹשִׁ֣יר חָדָ֑שׁ הֵיטִ֥יבוּ נַ֝גֵּ֗ן בִּתְרוּעָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Sing to him a new song; do well [at] playing with a shout of joy.

en.L: Sing to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} a new song; do well [at] playing with a shout of joy.
en.B: Sing {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} a new song; play your best, with shouts of joy.
en.R: Sing a new song to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. Play your instruments well, and shout with joy.

fr.L: Chantez-{{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} un chant nouveau ; jouez bien, avec un cri de joie.
fr.B: Chantez-{{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} un chant nouveau ; jouez de votre mieux, avec des cris de joie.
fr.R: Chantez un chant nouveau pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Jouez bien de vos instruments, et criez de joie.

sw.L: Mwimbieni wimbo mpya; pigeni vizuri pamoja na kelele za shangwe.
sw.B: Mwimbieni wimbo mpya; pigeni kwa ustadi wenu wote, pamoja na kelele za shangwe.
sw.R: Mwimbieni wimbo mpya. Pigeni vyombo vyenu vizuri, na mpige kelele kwa furaha.

es.L: {{plural_you:Cántenle|Cantadle}} un cántico nuevo; {{plural_you:toquen|tocad}} bien, con gritos de júbilo.
es.B: {{plural_you:Cántenle|Cantadle}} un cántico nuevo; {{plural_you:toquen|tocad}} lo mejor que {{plural_you:puedan|podáis}}, con gritos de alegría.
es.R: {{plural_you:Cántenle|Cantadle}} una canción nueva. {{plural_you:Toquen|Tocad}} bien sus instrumentos y {{plural_you:griten|gritad}} de alegría.

vi.L: Hãy hát cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} một bài ca mới; hãy khéo léo [trong việc] đàn với tiếng reo mừng.
vi.B: Hãy hát dâng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} một bài ca mới; hãy đàn hay hết sức mình, cùng với tiếng reo vui.
vi.R: Hãy hát một bài ca mới cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Hãy chơi đàn thật hay, và reo lên vui mừng.

decisions.choice: a new song: fresh praise for what God has done
decisions.reason: A new song answers a new act of God (40:4; 96:1; 98:1; Isaiah 42:10).

decisions.choice: shout of joy: a loud ringing cry
decisions.reason: The word (teru'ah) is the shout or trumpet blast of a festival or a battle (Numbers 10:5; 2 Samuel 6:15).

source.text: כִּֽי־יָשָׁ֥ר דְּבַר־יְהוָ֑ה וְכָל־מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗הוּ בֶּאֱמוּנָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: For upright [is] the word of YHWH, and all his work [is] in faithfulness.

en.L: For upright [is] the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} work [is done] in faithfulness.
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s word is right, and all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} deeds show {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithfulness.
en.R: Everything {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says is right. You can count on {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in everything {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} does.

fr.L: Car droite [est] la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et toute {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} œuvre [se fait] dans la fidélité.
fr.B: Car la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est droite, et toutes {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} œuvres montrent {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} fidélité.
fr.R: Tout ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est juste. Vous pouvez compter sur {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dans tout ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait.

sw.L: Kwa maana neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] adili, na kazi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} yote [imefanywa] kwa uaminifu.
sw.B: Kwa maana neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni la haki, na matendo {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} yote yanaonyesha uaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.R: Kila jambo analosema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni sawa. Unaweza kumtegemea katika kila jambo analolitenda.

es.L: Porque recta [es] la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y toda {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} obra [se hace] con fidelidad.
es.B: Porque la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} es recta, y todas {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} obras muestran {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} fidelidad.
es.R: Todo lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es correcto. Se puede confiar en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} en todo lo que hace.

vi.L: Vì ngay thẳng [là] lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và mọi công việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [đều được làm] trong sự thành tín.
vi.B: Vì lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là ngay thẳng, và mọi việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm đều bày tỏ sự thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Mọi điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán đều đúng. Người ta có thể tin cậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong mọi việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm.

decisions.choice: the word of the LORD: what he says and commands
decisions.reason: His word is both his promise and the command by which he made the world (verses 6 and 9).
The word ('emunah) means firmness, being dependable; all he does can be relied on.
Readable says what faithfulness means for people (m2).

source.text: אֹ֭הֵב צְדָקָ֣ה וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט חֶ֥סֶד יְ֝הוָ֗ה מָלְאָ֥ה הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: [He is] loving righteousness and justice; of the loyal love of YHWH the earth is full.

en.L: [He] loves righteousness and justice; of the loyal love of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the earth is full.
en.B: He loves what is right and just; {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s loyal love fills the whole earth.
en.R: He loves what is right and fair. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}}'s faithful love is everywhere on earth.

fr.L: [Il] aime la justice et le droit ; de l’amour loyal {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} la terre est pleine.
fr.B: Il aime ce qui est juste et droit ; l’amour fidèle {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} remplit toute la terre.
fr.R: Il aime ce qui est juste et honnête. L’amour fidèle {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est partout sur la terre.

sw.L: [Yeye] hupenda haki na hukumu ya adili; upendo usiokoma wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} umeijaza dunia.
sw.B: Yeye hupenda yaliyo haki na adili; upendo usiokoma wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} unaijaza dunia yote.
sw.R: Yeye hupenda yaliyo haki na yaliyo sawa. Upendo usiokoma wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} uko kila mahali duniani.

es.L: [Él] ama la justicia y el derecho; del amor leal {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} está llena la tierra.
es.B: Él ama lo que es recto y justo; el amor fiel {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} llena toda la tierra.
es.R: Él ama lo que es correcto y justo. El amor fiel {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} está por toda la tierra.

vi.L: [Ngài] yêu sự công chính và công lý; tình yêu thương thành tín của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tràn đầy trên đất.
vi.B: Ngài yêu điều công chính và công bằng; tình yêu thương thành tín của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tràn ngập khắp đất.
vi.R: Ngài yêu điều đúng và điều công bằng. Tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} có ở khắp nơi trên đất.

decisions.choice: righteousness and justice: what is right and fair
decisions.reason: The pair (tsedaqah and mishpat) describes right order in the world, and is what kings were to uphold (Jeremiah 22:15; 2 Samuel 8:15).

decisions.choice: loyal love: love that keeps its commitments
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is love that is faithful to a bond and goes beyond what is owed: the LORD's commitment to his people, shown in kindness and rescue (Exodus 34:6-7).
As in Psalms 1-12: "loyal love" keeps both the love and the faithfulness of the word; Readable says "faithful love".

decisions.choice: loving: the LORD is the one who loves
decisions.reason: The word is a participle with no subject; the LORD of verse 4 is meant, and his name follows in the next line.

source.text: בִּדְבַ֣ר יְ֭הוָה שָׁמַ֣יִם נַעֲשׂ֑וּ וּבְר֥וּחַ פִּ֝֗יו כָּל־צְבָאָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: By the word of YHWH [the] heavens were made, and by the breath of his mouth all their host.

en.L: By the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [the] heavens were made, and by the breath of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mouth all their host.
en.B: The heavens were made at {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s word, and the breath of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mouth made all their array of stars.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} spoke, and the sky was made. He breathed out a word, and all the stars came to be.

fr.L: Par la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} [les] cieux ont été faits, et par le souffle de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} bouche toute leur armée.
fr.B: Les cieux ont été faits par la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et le souffle de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} bouche a fait toute leur armée d’étoiles.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a parlé, et le ciel a été fait. Il a soufflé une parole, et toutes les étoiles ont existé.

sw.L: Kwa neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mbingu zilifanywa, na kwa pumzi ya kinywa {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} jeshi lao lote.
sw.B: Mbingu zilifanywa kwa neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na pumzi ya kinywa {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} ilifanya nyota zote zilizopangwa humo.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alisema, na anga likaumbwa. Alitamka neno, na nyota zote zikawepo.

es.L: Por la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} fueron hechos [los] cielos, y por el aliento de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} boca todo su ejército.
es.B: Los cielos fueron hechos por la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y el aliento de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} boca hizo toda su multitud de estrellas.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} habló, y el cielo fue hecho. Sopló una palabra, y todas las estrellas empezaron a existir.

vi.L: Bởi lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [các] tầng trời đã được dựng nên, và bởi hơi thở của miệng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cả muôn cơ binh của chúng.
vi.B: Các tầng trời được dựng nên bởi lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và hơi thở từ miệng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã dựng nên cả muôn vàn tinh tú.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán, và bầu trời được dựng nên. Ngài thở ra một lời, và mọi vì sao đều có ở đó.

decisions.choice: By the word ... the heavens were made: Genesis 1
decisions.reason: God made the world by speaking: "And God said, Let there be ..." (Genesis 1:3, 6, 14). Genesis 2:1 also speaks of the heavens "and all their host".

decisions.choice: the breath of his mouth: his spoken word
decisions.reason: The word (ruach) means breath, wind or spirit. In parallel with "word" it is the breath that carries the word (Isaiah 11:4).
The host of heaven is its great company, usually the stars (Isaiah 40:26), sometimes the angels (1 Kings 22:19).

decisions.choice: array of stars (B); all the stars (R)
decisions.reason: "Host" now means someone who receives guests; Balanced and Readable say what is meant (m3).

source.text: כֹּנֵ֣ס כַּ֭נֵּד מֵ֣י הַיָּ֑ם נֹתֵ֖ן בְּאֹצָר֣וֹת תְּהוֹמֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: Gathering like a heap the waters of the sea, putting in storehouses [the] deeps.

en.L: [He] gathers as a heap the waters of the sea; [{{deity_pronoun:he|He}}] puts [the] deeps in storehouses.
en.B: He heaps up the waters of the sea like a mound and keeps the ocean depths in storerooms.
en.R: He piles up the water of the sea like a heap. He keeps the deep oceans in storerooms.

fr.L: [Il] rassemble comme un monceau les eaux de la mer ; [{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}}] met [les] abîmes dans des réserves.
fr.B: Il amoncelle les eaux de la mer comme un tas et garde les profondeurs de l’océan dans des réserves.
fr.R: Il empile l’eau de la mer comme un tas. Il garde les océans profonds dans des réserves.

sw.L: [Yeye] hukusanya maji ya bahari kama chungu; [{{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}] huweka vilindi katika ghala.
sw.B: Huyakusanya maji ya bahari kama rundo, na kuvihifadhi vilindi vya bahari katika ghala.
sw.R: Huyarundika maji ya bahari kama lundo. Huhifadhi bahari zenye kina kirefu katika ghala.

es.L: [Él] junta como en un montón las aguas del mar; [{{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}] pone [los] abismos en depósitos.
es.B: Él amontona las aguas del mar como un cerro y guarda las profundidades del océano en almacenes.
es.R: Él amontona el agua del mar como en una pila. Guarda los océanos profundos en almacenes.

vi.L: [Ngài] gom nước biển lại như một đống; [{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}] đặt các vực sâu vào trong kho.
vi.B: Ngài dồn nước biển lại thành một đống và cất các vực sâu đại dương vào trong kho.
vi.R: Ngài chất nước biển lại như một đống. Ngài cất những đại dương sâu thẳm vào trong kho.

decisions.choice: like a heap: the waters piled up
decisions.reason: With the vowels of the Hebrew text the word means a heap, as when the sea stood up at the Exodus (Exodus 15:8; Joshua 3:13). The ancient Greek translation read the same letters as "wineskin": God holds the sea as in a bottle. The Hebrew text is followed.

decisions.choice: storehouses for the deeps: the waters under God's control
decisions.reason: The deep waters, which the ancient world feared as chaos, are kept in God's stores like grain or treasure (Job 38:22; Jeremiah 10:13).
The Hebrew uses participles with no subject ("gathering ..., putting ..."); Literal brackets the subject.

source.text: יִֽירְא֣וּ מֵ֭יְהוָה כָּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ מִמֶּ֥נּוּ יָ֝ג֗וּרוּ כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵ֥י תֵבֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: Let all the earth fear YHWH; of him let all [the] inhabitants of [the] world be in awe.

en.L: Let all the earth fear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} let all the inhabitants of the world be in awe.
en.B: Let the whole earth fear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; let everyone who lives in the world tremble with awe before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: Everyone on earth should have deep respect for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. All the people in the world should honor {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with awe.

fr.L: Que toute la terre craigne {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, que tous les habitants du monde soient saisis de crainte.
fr.B: Que la terre entière craigne {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; que tous les habitants du monde tremblent de respect devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.R: Tout le monde sur la terre devrait avoir un profond respect pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Tous les habitants du monde devraient {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}honorer avec crainte.

sw.L: Dunia yote na imche {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; wakaaji wote wa ulimwengu na wamstahi {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}.
sw.B: Dunia yote na imche {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; kila mtu anayeishi ulimwenguni atetemeke kwa hofu takatifu mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: Kila mtu duniani na amheshimu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa hofu takatifu. Watu wote ulimwenguni wamheshimu kwa unyenyekevu.

es.L: Tema {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} toda la tierra; ante {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} tiemblen todos los habitantes del mundo.
es.B: Que toda la tierra tema {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}; que todos los que viven en el mundo tiemblen con reverencia ante {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.R: Todos en la tierra deben tener profundo respeto por {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Toda la gente del mundo debe honrarlo con reverencia.

vi.L: Nguyện cả trái đất kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; nguyện mọi cư dân trên thế giới khiếp sợ trước {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Nguyện cả trái đất kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; nguyện mọi người sống trên thế gian run sợ kính cẩn trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Mọi người trên đất nên hết lòng tôn kính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Mọi người trên thế giới nên kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

decisions.reason: To fear the LORD is to take him seriously as God: reverence, awe and obedience (Proverbs 1:7). The parallel verb (gur) is to be in awe or to dread.

decisions.choice: all the earth: all its people
decisions.reason: "All the earth" means the people living on it, as the second line says.
Readable gives the sense of the fear meant here (m1).

decisions.choice: "kumcha BWANA" (L, B); "kumheshimu BWANA kwa hofu takatifu" at Readable, wherever the fear of the LORD comes in these psalms
decisions.reason: "Kumcha" is the Swahili verb for reverent fear of God, not plain fright; Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does.

source.text: כִּ֤י ה֣וּא אָמַ֣ר וַיֶּ֑הִי הֽוּא־צִ֝וָּ֗ה וַֽיַּעֲמֹֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: For he spoke and it was; he commanded and it stood.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke, and it came to be; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} commanded, and it stood.
en.B: For {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} only had to speak, and it was; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave the command, and there it stood.
en.R: He spoke, and the world was there. He gave an order, and it stood in its place.

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a parlé, et [cela] a été ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a commandé, et [cela] a tenu.
fr.B: Car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} n’a eu qu’à parler, et cela fut ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a donné l’ordre, et cela se tint là.
fr.R: Il a parlé, et le monde était là. Il a donné un ordre, et le monde a tenu à sa place.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} alisema, ikawa; {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} aliamuru, ikasimama.
sw.B: Kwa maana alihitaji tu kusema, na ikawa; alitoa amri, na ikasimama imara.
sw.R: Alisema, na ulimwengu ukawepo. Alitoa amri, nao ukasimama mahali pake.

es.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} habló, y fue; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} mandó, y se mantuvo firme.
es.B: Porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} no tuvo más que hablar, y así fue; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dio la orden, y allí quedó firme.
es.R: Él habló, y el mundo estuvo allí. Dio una orden, y quedó firme en su lugar.

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán, và [mọi vật] liền có; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã truyền lệnh, và [mọi vật] đứng vững.
vi.B: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chỉ phán một lời, thì mọi vật liền có; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} truyền lệnh, thì mọi vật đứng vững.
vi.R: Ngài phán, và thế giới liền có ở đó. Ngài ra lệnh, và mọi vật đứng vững ở chỗ của nó.

decisions.choice: he spoke and it was: Genesis 1
decisions.reason: As in verse 6: "God said ... and it was so" (Genesis 1:9, 11).
The Hebrew adds the pronoun twice for emphasis: it was he who spoke.
What he made stands in place and lasts, as his plans stand in verse 11.
Balanced brings out the ease and power of the word (m2).
Readable names what came to be, the world of verses 6-8.

source.text: יְֽהוָ֗ה הֵפִ֥יר עֲצַת־גּוֹיִ֑ם הֵ֝נִ֗יא מַחְשְׁב֥וֹת עַמִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH has broken [the] counsel of nations; he has frustrated [the] plans of peoples.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has broken the counsel of [the] nations; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has frustrated the plans of [the] peoples.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} brings the schemes of nations to nothing; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} blocks what the peoples plan.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} stops the plans of the nations. He keeps peoples from doing what they plan.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a brisé le conseil des nations ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait échouer les projets des peuples.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} réduit à rien les intrigues des nations ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait obstacle à ce que les peuples projettent.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} arrête les plans des nations. Il empêche les peuples de faire ce qu’ils ont prévu.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amevunja shauri la mataifa; amezibatilisha mipango ya watu.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huyafanya mashauri ya mataifa kuwa bure; huzuia yale ambayo watu wanapanga.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huzuia mipango ya mataifa. Huwazuia watu wasifanye yale wanayoyapanga.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha deshecho el consejo de [las] naciones; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha frustrado los planes de [los] pueblos.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} reduce a nada las intrigas de las naciones; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} impide lo que planean los pueblos.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} detiene los planes de las naciones. No deja que los pueblos hagan lo que planean.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phá tan mưu kế của [các] dân tộc; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm hỏng các kế hoạch của [các] dân.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm cho mưu đồ của các dân tộc ra hư không; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngăn trở những điều các dân toan tính.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} chặn đứng kế hoạch của các dân tộc. Ngài không để các dân làm được điều họ toan tính.

decisions.choice: has broken, has frustrated: what the LORD does
decisions.reason: The past forms state what the LORD has done and always does; Balanced and Readable use the present.
The same two words return in verse 11 for the LORD's own purposes: theirs fail, his stand.
Goyim and ʿammim are "las naciones" and "los pueblos", as these books settle; "gentiles" belongs to the New Testament's use.

decisions.choice: "các dân tộc" for the nations and "các dân" for the peoples
decisions.reason: The terms note keeps the two Hebrew words apart in this way through the Psalms.

source.text: עֲצַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה לְעוֹלָ֣ם תַּעֲמֹ֑ד מַחְשְׁב֥וֹת לִ֝בּ֗וֹ לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: The counsel of YHWH forever stands, the plans of his heart to generation and generation.

en.L: The counsel of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} stands forever, the plans of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} heart to generation and generation.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}}'s purpose stands firm forever, and what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has planned in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} heart lasts through every generation.
en.R: But what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} decides will last forever. His plans will go on for every generation.

fr.L: Le conseil {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} tient pour toujours, les projets de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} cœur de génération en génération.
fr.B: Le dessein {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} demeure ferme à jamais, et ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a projeté dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} cœur dure d’âge en âge.
fr.R: Mais ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} décide durera toujours. Ses plans continueront pour toutes les générations.

sw.L: Shauri la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} husimama milele, mipango ya moyo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kizazi hata kizazi.
sw.B: Kusudi la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} husimama imara milele, na yale aliyoyapanga moyoni {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}} hudumu katika kila kizazi.
sw.R: Lakini yale anayoamua {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yatadumu milele. Mipango {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} itaendelea katika kila kizazi.

es.L: El consejo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} permanece para siempre, los planes de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} corazón de generación en generación.
es.B: El propósito {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} se mantiene firme para siempre, y lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha planeado en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} corazón dura por todas las generaciones.
es.R: Pero lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} decide durará para siempre. Sus planes seguirán en pie por todas las generaciones.

vi.L: Mưu kế của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đứng vững đến đời đời, các ý định trong lòng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} từ thế hệ này đến thế hệ kia.
vi.B: Mục đích của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đứng vững mãi mãi, và những điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã định trong lòng còn mãi qua mọi thế hệ.
vi.R: Nhưng những gì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} quyết định sẽ còn mãi mãi. Kế hoạch của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ tiếp tục qua mọi thế hệ.

decisions.choice: counsel, plans: set against those of verse 10
decisions.reason: The same words as in verse 10; the contrast is plain without a "but".

decisions.choice: to generation and generation: through all time
decisions.reason: The doubled word means one generation after another, without end.
Readable marks the contrast with verse 10 (m1).

source.text: אַשְׁרֵ֣י הַ֭גּוֹי אֲשֶׁר־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו הָעָ֓ם׀בָּחַ֖ר לְנַחֲלָ֣ה לֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: How blessed [is] the nation whose God [is] YHWH, the people he has chosen for an inheritance for himself.

en.L: How blessed [is] the nation whose God [is] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the people [whom] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has chosen as an inheritance for {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}!
en.B: How blessed is the nation that has {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} as its God, the people {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} chose to be {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own possession!
en.R: Life is truly good for the nation that has {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} as its God. He chose that people to be {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} very own.

fr.L: Heureuse la nation dont le Dieu [est] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le peuple [qu’] {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a choisi comme héritage pour {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} !
fr.B: Heureuse la nation qui a {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} pour Dieu, le peuple qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a choisi pour être {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} bien propre !
fr.R: Quel bonheur pour la nation qui a {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} comme Dieu ! Il a choisi ce peuple pour qu’il soit vraiment à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: Heri taifa ambalo Mungu wake [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, watu [ambao] amewachagua kuwa urithi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}!
sw.B: Ana heri kweli taifa lililo na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kuwa Mungu wake, watu aliowachagua wawe mali {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}!
sw.R: Maisha ni mema kweli kwa taifa lililo na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kuwa Mungu wake. Aliwachagua watu hao wawe {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kabisa.

es.L: ¡Dichosa la nación cuyo Dios [es] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el pueblo [que] {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha escogido como heredad para {{deity_pronoun:sí|Sí}}!
es.B: ¡Qué dichosa es la nación que tiene {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} por Dios, el pueblo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} escogió para que fuera {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propia posesión!
es.R: La nación que tiene {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} como su Dios es verdaderamente feliz. Él escogió a ese pueblo para que fuera solo {{deity_pronoun:suyo|Suyo}}.

vi.L: Phước thay dân tộc có Đức Chúa Trời [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, là dân [mà] {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chọn làm cơ nghiệp cho chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!
vi.B: Phước hạnh thay dân tộc có {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đức Chúa Trời mình, là dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chọn làm sản nghiệp riêng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!
vi.R: Thật hạnh phúc cho dân tộc có {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đức Chúa Trời của họ. Ngài đã chọn dân ấy làm dân riêng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

decisions.reason: As in 1:1.
An inheritance is property that belongs to a family for good. Israel is the LORD's own share (Deuteronomy 32:9; Exodus 19:5).
The people chosen by the LORD is Israel, set against the nations of verse 10.
"Inheritance" suggests receiving something after a death; Balanced and Readable say what is meant (m2).

source.text: מִ֭שָּׁמַיִם הִבִּ֣יט יְהוָ֑ה רָ֝אָ֗ה אֶֽת־כָּל־בְּנֵ֥י הָאָדָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: From [the] heavens YHWH looks; he sees all [the] children of humankind.

en.L: From [the] heavens {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} looks; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sees all the {{gender:children of humankind|sons of men}}.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} looks out from heaven and sees every human being.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} looks at the earth from heaven. He sees every person there.

fr.L: Des cieux {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} regarde ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} voit tous les {{gender:enfants des humains|fils des hommes}}.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} regarde du haut du ciel et voit chaque être humain.
fr.R: Du ciel, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} regarde la terre. Il voit chaque personne qui s’y trouve.

sw.L: Kutoka mbinguni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hutazama; {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} huwaona wanadamu wote.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hutazama kutoka mbinguni na kumwona kila mwanadamu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huitazama dunia kutoka mbinguni. Humwona kila mtu aliye huko.

es.L: Desde [los] cielos mira {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ve a todos {{gender:los hijos de la humanidad|los hijos de los hombres}}.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mira desde el cielo y ve a todo ser humano.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mira la tierra desde el cielo. Ve a cada persona que está allí.

vi.L: Từ [các] tầng trời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nhìn xuống; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thấy hết thảy con cái loài người.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} từ trời nhìn xuống và thấy mọi người.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} từ trời nhìn xuống đất. Ngài thấy mọi người ở đó.

decisions.reason: As in 11:4, the phrase (bene ha'adam) means human beings.
The LORD's throne is in heaven (11:4); from there he sees all that happens.

decisions.choice: children of humankind, with "sons of men" as the alternative
decisions.reason: As in 11:4.

source.text: מִֽמְּכוֹן־שִׁבְתּ֥וֹ הִשְׁגִּ֑יחַ אֶ֖ל כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: From [the] place of his dwelling he gazes on all [the] inhabitants of the earth,

en.L: From the place of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} dwelling {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gazes on all the inhabitants of the earth,
en.B: From the place where {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} lives {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} keeps {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} eye on everyone who lives on the earth,
en.R: From {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} home in heaven, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} watches all the people who live on the earth.

fr.L: Du lieu de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} demeure {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} observe tous les habitants de la terre,
fr.B: Du lieu où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} habite, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} garde l’œil sur tous ceux qui vivent sur la terre,
fr.R: De {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} maison dans le ciel, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} surveille tous les gens qui vivent sur la terre.

sw.L: Kutoka mahali pa makao {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} huwaangalia wakaaji wote wa dunia,
sw.B: Kutoka mahali anapoishi, huwaangalia kwa makini wote wanaoishi duniani,
sw.R: Kutoka nyumbani {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} mbinguni, huwatazama watu wote wanaoishi duniani.

es.L: Desde el lugar de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} morada {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} contempla a todos los habitantes de la tierra,
es.B: Desde el lugar donde {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} vive, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} vigila a todos los que viven en la tierra,
es.R: Desde {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} casa en el cielo, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} observa a toda la gente que vive en la tierra.

vi.L: Từ nơi ngự của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chăm chú nhìn mọi cư dân trên đất,
vi.B: Từ nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngự, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} để mắt trông chừng mọi người sống trên đất,
vi.R: Từ nhà của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên trời, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} theo dõi mọi người sống trên đất.

decisions.choice: the place of his dwelling: his fixed abode
decisions.reason: The word (makon) is a firm, set place; the verb can mean to dwell or to sit enthroned (1 Kings 8:39).
A rare verb (shagach) for looking out intently (Song 2:9).
Readable names the place from verse 13.

source.text: הַיֹּצֵ֣ר יַ֣חַד לִבָּ֑ם הַ֝מֵּבִ֗ין אֶל־כָּל־מַעֲשֵׂיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: the one forming together their heart, the one discerning to all their deeds.

en.L: the one who forms their hearts all alike, who gives heed to all their deeds.
en.B: the one who shaped every one of their hearts and who notices everything they do.
en.R: He made the hearts of all people, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} understands everything they do.

fr.L: {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui forme leur cœur à tous également, qui prête attention à toutes leurs œuvres.
fr.B: {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui a façonné le cœur de chacun d’eux et qui remarque tout ce qu’ils font.
fr.R: Il a fait le cœur de tous les humains, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} comprend tout ce qu’ils font.

sw.L: {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} aiumbaye mioyo yao wote pia, ayaangaliaye matendo yao yote.
sw.B: ndiye aliyeiumba mioyo ya kila mmoja wao, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} huyaona yote wanayoyatenda.
sw.R: Yeye aliiumba mioyo ya watu wote, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} anaelewa kila kitu wanachokifanya.

es.L: el que forma el corazón de todos ellos por igual, el que atiende a todas sus obras.
es.B: el que formó el corazón de cada uno de ellos y el que se fija en todo lo que hacen.
es.R: Él hizo el corazón de todas las personas, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} entiende todo lo que hacen.

vi.L: là Đấng nắn nên lòng của hết thảy họ, là Đấng để ý đến mọi việc làm của họ.
vi.B: là Đấng đã nắn nên lòng của từng người và để ý đến mọi việc họ làm.
vi.R: Ngài đã tạo nên lòng của mọi người, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hiểu mọi điều họ làm.

decisions.choice: the one forming ... the one discerning: the LORD of verse 14
decisions.reason: The two participles describe the one who looks down in verses 13-14; the sentence runs on from verse 14.
The verb (yatsar) is used of a potter and of God forming the first human (Genesis 2:7). The one who made the heart knows it.
The word (yachad) means together or alike; he formed the hearts of all people.

source.text: אֵֽין־הַ֭מֶּלֶךְ נוֹשָׁ֣ע בְּרָב־חָ֑יִל גִּ֝בּ֗וֹר לֹֽא־יִנָּצֵ֥ל בְּרָב־כֹּֽחַ׃

records.literal_gloss: There is not the king saved by greatness of an army; a warrior is not delivered by greatness of strength.

en.L: The king is not saved by [the] greatness of an army; a warrior is not delivered by greatness of strength.
en.B: No king wins the day because his army is large; no warrior escapes because his strength is great.
en.R: A king is not saved just because he has a big army. A strong soldier is not rescued just because he is strong.

fr.L: Le roi n’est pas sauvé par [la] grandeur d’une armée ; un guerrier n’est pas délivré par [la] grandeur de [sa] force.
fr.B: Aucun roi n’est vainqueur parce que son armée est nombreuse ; aucun guerrier n’échappe parce que sa force est grande.
fr.R: Un roi n’est pas sauvé simplement parce qu’il a une grande armée. Un soldat fort n’est pas délivré simplement parce qu’il est fort.

sw.L: Mfalme haokolewi kwa wingi wa jeshi; shujaa haponyeshwi kwa wingi wa nguvu.
sw.B: Hakuna mfalme anayeshinda kwa sababu jeshi lake ni kubwa; hakuna shujaa anayeokoka kwa sababu nguvu zake ni nyingi.
sw.R: Mfalme haokolewi kwa sababu tu ana jeshi kubwa. Askari hodari haokolewi kwa sababu tu ana nguvu.

es.L: El rey no se salva por la grandeza de un ejército; el guerrero no se libra por la grandeza de su fuerza.
es.B: Ningún rey gana la batalla porque su ejército sea grande; ningún guerrero escapa porque su fuerza sea mucha.
es.R: Un rey no se salva solo porque tenga un ejército grande. Un soldado fuerte no se libra solo porque sea fuerte.

vi.L: Vua không được cứu nhờ đạo quân đông đảo; dũng sĩ không được giải cứu nhờ sức mạnh lớn lao.
vi.B: Chẳng vua nào thắng trận nhờ quân đội đông; chẳng dũng sĩ nào thoát nạn nhờ sức mạnh lớn.
vi.R: Một vị vua không được cứu chỉ vì có đạo quân đông. Một người lính mạnh mẽ không được giải cứu chỉ vì người ấy mạnh.

decisions.reason: In battle, to be saved (yasha') is to come through and win. Victory belongs to the LORD (verse 17; 20:7-8).
The word (chayil) can mean strength, wealth or an army; with "king" it means his forces.

source.text: שֶׁ֣קֶר הַ֭סּוּס לִתְשׁוּעָ֑ה וּבְרֹ֥ב חֵ֝יל֗וֹ לֹ֣א יְמַלֵּֽט׃

records.literal_gloss: A lie [is] the horse for victory, and by the greatness of its strength it does not rescue.

en.L: A lie [is] the horse for victory, and by the greatness of its strength it does not rescue.
en.B: The horse is a deceptive hope for victory; with all its great strength it saves no one.
en.R: Horses cannot win a battle for you. They may be strong, but they cannot save anyone.

fr.L: Un mensonge [est] le cheval pour la victoire, et par la grandeur de sa force il ne délivre pas.
fr.B: Le cheval est un espoir trompeur pour gagner ; malgré toute sa force, il ne sauve personne.
fr.R: Les chevaux ne peuvent pas gagner une bataille pour vous. Ils sont peut-être forts, mais ils ne peuvent sauver personne.

sw.L: Uongo [ni] farasi kwa ushindi, wala kwa wingi wa nguvu zake haokoi.
sw.B: Farasi ni tumaini la uongo la kupata ushindi; pamoja na nguvu zake zote hamwokoi mtu yeyote.
sw.R: Farasi hawawezi kukushindia vita. Huenda wakawa na nguvu, lakini hawawezi kumwokoa mtu yeyote.

es.L: Mentira [es] el caballo para la victoria, y por la grandeza de su fuerza no libra.
es.B: El caballo es una esperanza engañosa para la victoria; con toda su gran fuerza no salva a nadie.
es.R: Los caballos no pueden ganar una batalla por ti. Pueden ser fuertes, pero no pueden salvar a nadie.

vi.L: Dối trá [là] con ngựa để đem lại chiến thắng, và bởi sức mạnh lớn lao của nó, nó không giải cứu được.
vi.B: Trông vào ngựa để thắng trận là hy vọng hão huyền; dù sức nó mạnh đến đâu, nó cũng chẳng cứu được ai.
vi.R: Ngựa không thể giúp người ta thắng trận. Chúng có thể mạnh, nhưng chúng không cứu được ai.

decisions.choice: the horse: the power of war chariots and cavalry
decisions.reason: Horses meant military strength, which Israel's kings were warned not to trust (Deuteronomy 17:16; 20:8; Isaiah 31:1).

decisions.choice: a lie: a hope that lets you down
decisions.reason: The word (sheqer) means falsehood; to trust a horse for victory is to trust something that will fail.
The word (teshu'ah) is rescue or salvation; in a battle it is victory.

decisions.choice: cannot win a battle for you
alternatives: is a false hope for victory
decisions.reason: Readable states the point plainly (m2).

source.text: הִנֵּ֤ה עֵ֣ין יְ֭הוָה אֶל־יְרֵאָ֑יו לַֽמְיַחֲלִ֥ים לְחַסְדּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, [the] eye of YHWH [is] to those fearing him, to those who wait for his loyal love,

en.L: Look, the eye of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] on those who fear {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, on those who wait for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love,
en.B: Look, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} keeps watch over those who fear {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, who wait with hope for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love,
en.R: Look! {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} watches over people who honor {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. They trust {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to show them {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithful love.

fr.L: Voici, l’œil {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} [est] sur ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} craignent, sur ceux qui espèrent en {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal,
fr.B: Voici, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} veille sur ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} craignent, qui attendent avec espoir {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle,
fr.R: Regardez ! {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} veille sur ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}honorent. Ils comptent sur {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} pour leur montrer {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle.

sw.L: Tazama, jicho la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [liko] juu ya wale wanaomcha, juu ya wale wanaongojea upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma,
sw.B: Tazama, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huwaangalia wale wanaomcha, wanaongoja kwa tumaini upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma,
sw.R: Tazama! {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huwalinda watu wanaomheshimu. Wanamtumaini kwamba atawaonyesha upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma.

es.L: Mira, el ojo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} [está] sobre los que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} temen, sobre los que esperan {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor leal,
es.B: Mira, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} vigila a los que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} temen, a los que esperan con esperanza {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel,
es.R: ¡Mira! {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} cuida a las personas que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} honran. Ellas confían en que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les mostrará {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel.

vi.L: Kìa, mắt của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [ở] trên những người kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, trên những người trông đợi tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}},
vi.B: Kìa, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} canh giữ những người kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là những người đầy hy vọng trông đợi tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}},
vi.R: Hãy xem! {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trông chừng những người tôn kính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Họ tin cậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ bày tỏ cho họ tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

decisions.choice: the eye of the LORD: his watchful care
decisions.reason: As in 32:8: his eye rests on them for good.
The verb (yachal) means to wait with expectation.

decisions.choice: Look: in contrast to the horse and the army
decisions.reason: The word (hinneh) points to the true source of rescue after verses 16-17.

decisions.choice: loyal love: love that keeps its commitments
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is love that is faithful to a bond and goes beyond what is owed: the LORD's commitment to his people, shown in kindness and rescue (Exodus 34:6-7).
As in Psalms 1-12: "loyal love" keeps both the love and the faithfulness of the word; Readable says "faithful love".
As in verse 8.

source.text: לְהַצִּ֣יל מִמָּ֣וֶת נַפְשָׁ֑ם וּ֝לְחַיּוֹתָ֗ם בָּרָעָֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: to deliver from death their soul and to keep them alive in famine.

en.L: to deliver their soul from death and to keep them alive in famine.
en.B: to save their lives from death and to keep them living through famine.
en.R: He rescues them from death. When there is no food, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} keeps them alive.

fr.L: pour délivrer leur âme de la mort et pour les garder en vie dans la famine.
fr.B: pour arracher leur vie à la mort et les faire vivre au temps de la famine.
fr.R: Il les sauve de la mort. Quand il n’y a plus de nourriture, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les garde en vie.

sw.L: ili kuiponya nafsi yao na mauti na kuwahifadhi hai wakati wa njaa.
sw.B: ili kuyaokoa maisha yao na kifo na kuwaweka hai wakati wa njaa.
sw.R: Huwaokoa na kifo. Kunapokuwa hakuna chakula, huwaweka hai.

es.L: para librar de la muerte su alma y para mantenerlos con vida en el hambre.
es.B: para salvar de la muerte sus vidas y mantenerlos vivos durante el hambre.
es.R: Él los rescata de la muerte. Cuando no hay comida, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los mantiene con vida.

vi.L: để giải cứu linh hồn họ khỏi sự chết và giữ họ sống trong cơn đói kém.
vi.B: để cứu mạng sống họ khỏi sự chết và giữ cho họ còn sống qua cơn đói kém.
vi.R: Ngài cứu họ khỏi chết. Khi không có thức ăn, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giữ cho họ sống.

decisions.reason: The word (nefesh) is the living person, here their life itself.

decisions.choice: to deliver ... to keep alive: why the LORD watches
decisions.reason: The sentence from verse 18 goes on to say what his watchful eye is for.
Balanced and Readable say what nefesh means here (m1).

source.text: נַ֭פְשֵׁנוּ חִכְּתָ֣ה לַֽיהוָ֑ה עֶזְרֵ֖נוּ וּמָגִנֵּ֣נוּ הֽוּא׃

records.literal_gloss: Our soul waits for YHWH; our help and our shield [is] he.

en.L: Our soul waits for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; our help and our shield [is] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}.
en.B: With all our being we wait for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is the one who helps us and shields us.
en.R: We are waiting for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to act. He helps us and protects us like a shield.

fr.L: Notre âme attend {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; notre secours et notre bouclier, [c’est] {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: De tout notre être nous attendons {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui nous secourt et qui nous protège.
fr.R: Nous attendons que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} agisse. Il nous aide et nous protège comme un bouclier.

sw.L: Nafsi yetu inamngojea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; msaada wetu na ngao yetu [ni] {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}.
sw.B: Kwa nafsi zetu zote tunamngojea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ndiye anayetusaidia na kutukinga kama ngao.
sw.R: Tunamngojea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atende. Yeye hutusaidia na kutulinda kama ngao.

es.L: Nuestra alma espera {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}; nuestra ayuda y nuestro escudo [es] {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.B: Con todo nuestro ser esperamos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es el que nos ayuda y nos protege como un escudo.
es.R: Estamos esperando que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} actúe. Él nos ayuda y nos protege como un escudo.

vi.L: Linh hồn chúng tôi trông đợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; sự giúp đỡ và cái khiên của chúng tôi [là] {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Với cả con người mình, chúng tôi trông đợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đấng giúp đỡ và che chở chúng tôi như cái khiên.
vi.R: Chúng tôi đang chờ đợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hành động. Ngài giúp đỡ chúng tôi và che chở chúng tôi như một cái khiên.

decisions.reason: "Our soul" (nefesh) is the whole self: we wait with our whole being.
As in 3:4; 18:3: God himself is the defense of his people.
Readable says what they wait for: the LORD's help.

source.text: כִּי־ב֭וֹ יִשְׂמַ֣ח לִבֵּ֑נוּ כִּ֤י בְשֵׁ֖ם קָדְשׁ֣וֹ בָטָֽחְנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: For in him our heart rejoices, for in [the] name of his holiness we have trusted.

en.L: For in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} our heart is glad, for in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy name we have trusted.
en.B: Our hearts are glad in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, because we have put our trust in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy name.
en.R: We are happy because of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. We trust {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, the holy God.

fr.L: Car en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} notre cœur se réjouit, car en {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} saint nom nous avons eu confiance.
fr.B: Notre cœur se réjouit en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, parce que nous avons mis notre confiance en {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} saint nom.
fr.R: Nous sommes heureux grâce à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Nous {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} faisons confiance, à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, le Dieu saint.

sw.L: Kwa maana ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} moyo wetu unafurahi, kwa maana katika jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} takatifu tumetumaini.
sw.B: Mioyo yetu inafurahi ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, kwa sababu tumeliweka tumaini letu katika jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} takatifu.
sw.R: Tunafurahi kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Tunamtumaini {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}, Mungu mtakatifu.

es.L: Porque en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se alegra nuestro corazón, porque en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santo nombre hemos confiado.
es.B: Nuestro corazón se alegra en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, porque hemos puesto nuestra confianza en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santo nombre.
es.R: Estamos felices por causa de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Confiamos en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, el Dios santo.

vi.L: Vì trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lòng chúng tôi vui mừng, vì nơi danh thánh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chúng tôi đã tin cậy.
vi.B: Lòng chúng tôi vui mừng trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì chúng tôi đã đặt lòng tin cậy nơi danh thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Chúng tôi vui mừng vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Chúng tôi tin cậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là Đức Chúa Trời thánh.

decisions.choice: his holy name: the LORD himself as he has made himself known
decisions.reason: A name stands for the person; to trust in his name is to trust him (20:8).

decisions.choice: we have trusted: a settled trust
decisions.reason: The past form describes trust already placed and still held.
Readable says what the name stands for (m1).

source.text: יְהִֽי־חַסְדְּךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה עָלֵ֑ינוּ כַּ֝אֲשֶׁ֗ר יִחַ֥לְנוּ לָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: Let your loyal love, YHWH, be on us, just as we have waited for you.

en.L: Let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, be upon us, just as we have waited for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love be over us, in keeping with our hope in {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, show us {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful love, because we are waiting and hoping for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

fr.L: Que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour loyal, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, soit sur nous, selon que nous avons espéré en {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle soit sur nous, à la mesure de notre espoir en {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, montre-nous {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle, car nous {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}attendons et nous espérons en {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

sw.L: Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, uwe juu yetu, kama vile tulivyokungojea {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma na uwe juu yetu, sawasawa na tumaini letu {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, utuonyeshe upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma, kwa sababu tunakungojea na kukutumaini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}.

es.L: Sea {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor leal, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, sobre nosotros, así como hemos esperado en {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel esté sobre nosotros, conforme a nuestra esperanza en {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, muéstranos {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel, porque estamos esperando y confiando en {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

vi.L: Nguyện tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, ở trên chúng tôi, như chúng tôi đã trông đợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, nguyện tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bao phủ chúng tôi, đúng như niềm hy vọng chúng tôi đặt nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin bày tỏ cho chúng tôi tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì chúng tôi đang chờ đợi và hy vọng nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

decisions.choice: loyal love: love that keeps its commitments
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is love that is faithful to a bond and goes beyond what is owed: the LORD's commitment to his people, shown in kindness and rescue (Exodus 34:6-7).
As in Psalms 1-12: "loyal love" keeps both the love and the faithfulness of the word; Readable says "faithful love".

decisions.choice: just as: in keeping with our hope
decisions.reason: The words (ka'asher) ask that God's love match the hope they have placed in him; they also give the reason for the request.

decisions.choice: we have waited: we have hoped
decisions.reason: The same verb as in verse 18: the psalm ends where those who wait for his love are watched over.
